name: Second Room
detailed_description:
It contains two types of games: an game like "8番出口" which you have to escape from an endless series of rooms by progressing to the correct room, and a legacy version in which you have to survive for seven days by looking for anomalies and dolls and completing the game to escape from the room safely

Game like "8番出口"

This is an Game like "8番出口" where you have to escape from an endless number of rooms by going to the correct room.

Rules.

Go to the correct room.

If something happens in a room, return to the previous room and go to another room.

legacy version

You have come to a haunted place called “The Second Room” and are trapped in the room by a bizarre phenomenon. You must survive for 7 days and escape from the room safely by looking for anomalies and dolls and completing the game.

Game Contents

1.Search for anomalies

2.Collect dolls

3. Run away from Mary.

Repeat these steps to clear the stage.

*This is a game in which you have to find a mistake. The game will be cleared when you have collected all the dolls while purifying the strange phenomena (mistakes) that occur over time. If you leave the strange phenomenon unattended, your SAN value will decrease.

However, please run away from Mary!

Rules

1. Memorize the room. When you finish learning, start playing hide-and-seek by yourself.

2.Please look for stuffed animals.

3. If a bizarre phenomenon occurs, purify it immediately.

You can purify the strange phenomenon with the purifying bell, but it will damage your spirit after a while (SAN value will decrease).

If the purification is successful, the SAN value will be restored.

4. When the SAN value reaches 0, you will go crazy and GameOver will occur.

Caution!

There is Ms. Merry in this room!

Please run away from Mary!

Hide from Ms. Merry!

Do not hold on to Mary!

Do not touch Ms. Merry!

About the horror scenes

Scary of the game ★☆☆☆☆

This game includes a surprise performance using jumpscares, but it is produced under the concept of the cutest jumpscares in Japan, so that even those who are not good at horror can enjoy the game.

However, for the sake of the story, the game includes expressions and horror scenes that suggest that a murder has occurred in the past.

Play time

Estimated clear time 2~3 hours

Voice

Input text reading software “VOICEPEAK Koharu Rokka” is used.

Permission for Live Broadcast

Monetization of live game distribution and video posting of this game is permitted only on the following distribution platforms.

YouTube

Twitch

OPENREC.tv

Nico Nico Douga/Live Broadcast

Twitter

However, please follow the guidelines below.

・Monetization is only permitted when using the monetization function provided by the distribution platform for contributors.

・Available for both individuals and corporations.

・We do not permit video distribution or posting of videos that are limited to paying members, such as members-only distribution.

・Please refrain from posting videos that do not contain any creativity or comments intended to spoil the game content (e.g., game play-by-play or video game commentary).

(e.g., videos summarizing anomalies that do not include game play or reactions, etc.)

*This guideline does not prohibit the compilation of videos of reactions to anomalies by clipping from game distribution, etc.

**These guidelines are subject to change without notice. Please check these guidelines before distributing or posting videos.
